decisions.reason: After being visibly launched and then retained once already, the evening psychiatric day-patient program has accumulated commitment and fits the firm's psychiatric care expansion, so management is very likely to persist and treat any weak results as temporary.

The carpentry workshop is tied to the firm's rehabilitation and sheltered-work capabilities and has its own public presence, so despite some commercial uncertainty management would be inclined to continue rather than reverse an invested initiative.

Because the counseling service for senior living is closely connected to the firm's eldercare mission and was prominently presented, management would be reluctant to withdraw a service that publicly supports its announced direction.

The meal delivery service is less visibly committed than the other products, but it is close to the core senior-support offer and in an expanding firm management would usually give such a new service more time before admitting failure.
